# This Matter

> Comprehensive educational resource covering personal finance, insurance, taxes, bankruptcy, and debt management with illustrated tutorials and practical guides.

This Matter is an educational website created by William C. Spaulding that provides in-depth, accessible tutorials on complex financial topics including insurance products, tax planning, bankruptcy procedures, and debt collection. The site combines clear explanations with visual aids to help readers understand personal finance fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Chapter 7 Bankruptcy
- Chapter 13 Bankruptcy
- Term Life Insurance
- Whole Life Insurance
- Health Insurance
- Tax Credits
- Tax Deductions
- Retirement Plans
- Medicare and Medigap
- Child Tax Credit
- American Opportunity Credit
- Homeowners Insurance
- Variable Life Insurance
- Annuities
- Creditors Meeting

## Insurance Fundamentals

- [Insurance: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/insurance): Comprehensive tutorials on insurance fundamentals and how it works
- [Types of Insurance: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/insurance/types): Illustrated tutorials covering all major types of insurance products
- [Life Insurance: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/insurance/types/life): Illustrated tutorials on life insurance types: term, whole, variable, universal
- [Health Insurance: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/insurance/types/health): Illustrated tutorials on health insurance, disability, and long-term care
- [Homeowner's Insurance: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/insurance/types/toc-homeowners-insurance.htm): Tutorials on homeowners insurance policies, endorsements, and costs

## Retirement & Tax Planning

- [Retirement Plans: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/tax/toc-retirement-plans.htm): Tutorials on retirement plans including IRAs, 401ks, and HSAs
- [Tax Credits: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/tax/tax-credits): Comprehensive guide to tax credits: earned income, child, adoption, education
- [Personal Tax Deductions: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/tax/toc-personal-deductions.htm): Tutorials on personal tax deductions and credits with examples
- [Educational Tax Benefits: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/tax/toc-educational-tax-benefits.htm): Tutorials on education tax credits, 529 plans, and savings accounts

## Bankruptcy & Debt Management

- [Chapter 7 Bankruptcy: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/credit/bankruptcy/chapter-7): Illustrated tutorials on Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation process
- [Chapter 13 Bankruptcy: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/credit/bankruptcy/chapter-13): Illustrated tutorials on Chapter 13 bankruptcy repayment plans
- [Chapter 11 Bankruptcy: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/credit/bankruptcy/chapter-11): Tutorials on Chapter 11 business bankruptcy reorganization plans
- [Debt Collection: Table of Contents](https://thismatter.com/money/credit/debt): Tutorials on debt collection, creditor rights, and judgment enforcement

## Investment & Broker Resources

- [Comparing Option Trading Prices at Fidelity, Robinhood, Charles Schwab, and Vanguard](https://thismatter.com/blog/option-costs-broker-comparison.htm): Broker comparison of option trading fees at Fidelity, Robinhood, Schwab, Vanguard
